conclusions: The joint fit retains similar isolated-window next-token NLL on 65456 targets but loses constrained reading/science task accuracy in this 96-question panel.
Frozen cached-prefix scores are exact68/96, attention66/96, joint49/96. Secondary full-prefill scores are68/96,67/96,50/96; the main task regression persists.
Joint BoolQ accuracy is10/32 versus24/32 exact in both execution paths. The panel is imbalanced27 Yes/5 No; joint predicts No27 times. Do not generalize this raw score as standard BoolQ accuracy.
Primary task comparisons include24 original-correct to joint-wrong changes and5 original-wrong to joint-correct changes.
Some BF16 decisions vary by cached versus full-prompt execution: prediction agreement95/96 exact,93/96 attention,95/96 joint. The paths are not numerically identical.
This establishes a task-retention target for further MLP fitting. It does not establish a specific remedy, a universally worse model, or composition across more compressed layers.
